correctness.rationale: Re-derived Poisson K_X(t)=lambda(Ee^(tJ)-1-tEJ), V=lambda EJ^2. Exact second-order remainder factorization K_X=Vt²/2 Ee^(tR) uses independent U~Beta(1,2), size-biased Y/L~Beta(alpha+2,beta), R=UY. The coefficients A_n=2(a)_n/((n+2)!(b)_n), a=alpha+2,b=a+beta, have A_{n+1}/A_n=(a+n)/((b+n)(n+3)) and difference from m0=a/(3b) equal n[b(3-a)-a(n+3)]/[3b(b+n)(n+3)]. Thus A_n<=m0^n all n iff b(3-a)<=4a, equivalent to alpha>=1 or beta<=a(a+1)/(1-alpha) when alpha<1; coefficientwise geometric majorant proves c*=Lm0. Otherwise A2>A1², local positive derivative of Psi=(1-1/F)/s implies c*>Lm0 with finite positive maximizer since Psi(s)->0 at infinity. Independently symbolically verified at b0=4a/(3-a): u=0,u_prime=(3-a)^4/[1728a(a+1)],v=-(3-a)^4/[8640(a+3)]<0, giving unique near-critical optimizer and exact stated quadratic gain via IFT and uniform-away-from-zero global gap. The local checks of rational coefficients are diagnostic, not a substitute for the entire coefficientwise proof.
residual_risks: The theorem asserts uniqueness of positive optimizer only near the critical boundary; no global uniqueness away from it and no elementary global interior value.
The right-sided scale is fixed to the TRUE variance V; allowing larger proxy or signed jumps changes the question.
